# Show slice intersections in the views and enable interactive translation/rotation.
# Backing API: vtkMRMLSliceDisplayNode (one per slice view).
#   - SetIntersectingSlicesVisibility  -> show/hide slice intersection lines

    # Enable interaction with the slice intersections
    sliceDisplayNode.SetIntersectingSlicesInteractive(True)
    # Ensure both translation and rotation handle modes are enabled

    sliceDisplayNode.SetIntersectingSlicesRotationEnabled(True)

    if not sliceDisplayNode.GetIntersectingSlicesInteractive():

# BoneReconstructionPlanner (extension) defines its custom layout in its own source:
#   slicer.BRPLayoutId = 101
